text_block_list.text:
The Summer Walk has begun. The Umamusume 
seem to be enjoying their vacation at the 
resort in their own ways.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey Trainer, take a pic, take a pic!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I just ran into Helios and Curren-chan! 
We're gonna jump on three, so snap the 
photo then!

I take the smartphone and snap the photo 
the moment the three of them jump.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Man, this is hoooorrible!! The framing is 
so boring!! Why'd you take an extreme 
close-up?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah hahaha☆ Seriously?! LOL! It's so 
blurry, that's hilarious☆★

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's take the next one☆ Matching 
poses, pretty please~!
(Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahahahaha! Awesome☆★ Wait, it looks 
totally like an ID photo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Isn't that practically a miracle in 
its own right? Capturing a moment that 
looks just like an ID photo is amazing~!
choice_data_list: N-Next time, I'll definitely get it right!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then let's check out some photogenic 
spots. Make sure you capture lots of cute 
Karens, okay~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Look at this! It says 
'#EvenOutofFocusCurrenChanIsCute'♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Wahahaha! The comment section is super 
hyped up~~!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Man... hey, seriously, give me a break. I 
didn't think it'd be this insane...!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, aah!! I'm itching all over! Time for 
some super intense special training!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, why wouldn't I take a photo?
choice_data_list:
In the first place, I don't really get 
what's 'photogenic'...

text_block_list.text:
If I could at least understand what they 
mean by "Instagrammable," I feel like I 
could reflect it in my photos. Though I 
have no concept of what that feels like to 
begin with.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously? You're starting all the way 
from there?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Well then,

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What do you think of this?

What was presented to me were photos taken 
by Tosen Jordan. A vibrant lineup of 
eye-catching foods and gorgeous scenery.

Yet, what caught my eye among those photos 
was the person in the picture with her—
choice_data_list: Jordan looks like she's having fun.
Jordan looks like she's having fun

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Mm, see? I don't really know how to put it 
into words, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Don't you have them too? Things that make 
your heart flutter... or times when you're 
just having so much fun?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's kinda like having all that 
stuff packed into one tight bundle. One 
look at it and your hype instantly shoots 
through the roof—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It was so emotional, or like, rare? 
Crazy cool... You know what I mean, 
right...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: In other words... Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sheesh, go stand over there for a sec! 
We gotta shoot the ocean whoooosh from 
below too...!

Looking at the photo shown to me, there I 
stood against the sea breeze, on the 
water's edge dyed by the sunset.
choice_data_list: It's just like a scene from a movie...
It's like a scene from a movie...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pffft! Wow, romantic much?! I actually 
burst out laughing!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I can kind of get it. Like, being 
the main character of your own life, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's it. The protagonist. Like the 
star of the show right in the middle of 
all the sparkle!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that feel, like, super special? 
And kinda exciting, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ain't feeling that way what being 
'aesthetic' is all about?
choice_data_list: Oh, somehow... I feel like I get it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Puha, are you serious! Can you really 
figure it out that simply?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, go on. Try taking a picture~

Facing the sparkling ocean, I take a photo 
of her against the light. Within the 
orange scenery bathed in sunshine, a 
cheerful silhouette emerged.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. Sounds good to me.
